claims: There are four astronauts on the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission is a round-trip mission around the Moon.
Reid Wiseman (NASA) is the Commander on the Artemis II mission.
Victor Glover (NASA) is the Pilot on the Artemis II mission.
Christina Koch (NASA) is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
Jeremy Hansen (CSA) is a Mission Specialist on the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
The Artemis II crew is the first crew to travel to the lunar vicinity since 1972.
